title: REQ-20261109-OPS003 — Transfer balance account history & cap space: $1,250,000 credit, $850,000 remaining (George Papadopoulos)
content:
Transfer balance account (TBA) review for George Papadopoulos (DOB 03/04/1960, age 66), prepared by Benefits & Eligibility for the commencement of Caldova Pension CP-3077881.

History: George has never had a retirement-phase income stream with Caldova or any other fund — confirmed by the adviser's declaration and by George's ATO transfer balance account record, which shows no credits or debits. Because he has no existing transfer balance account, his personal transfer balance cap is set at the general cap in force when his first retirement-phase income stream starts: $2.1 million for 2026-27 (the general cap was $2.0 million in 2025-26).

Proposed event: transfer balance credit of $1,250,000 on 16 Nov 2026 (the commencement value of CP-3077881).

Cap calculation: personal cap $2,100,000 − credit $1,250,000 = remaining cap space $850,000. Cap used: 59.52% ($1,250,000 ÷ $2,100,000); unused: 40.48%. The unused percentage matters if the general cap is indexed in a later year — George's personal cap would then increase proportionally.

Result: within the cap ✅ — nothing over the cap, so nothing to commute and no extra tax.

Notes: the $34,600 left in accumulation (CS-1077881) does not count towards the cap; its earnings stay taxed at up to 15%. Regular pension payments do not reduce George's transfer balance account; a commutation (a lump sum taken out of the pension) would create a debit and restore cap space. Reversionary: if George dies first, the pension reverts to Helen and her transfer balance account receives a credit equal to the pension's value at the date of death, 12 months after the death. Helen has no transfer balance account at present. Division 296 is not relevant: George's total super balance is well below $3 million.

Reporting: after commencement, Transfers & Rollovers report the $1,250,000 transfer balance credit (16 Nov 2026) to the ATO through Caldova's transfer balance account reporting.
